stories.title: ЕР лидирует на выборах в Госдуму после обработки более половины протоколов

en.title: ER leads State Duma elections after processing over half of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections based on results from more than 50 percent of counted polling protocols.

stories.title: Кандидат от ЕР побеждает на выборах в Госдуму в Хакасии после обработки 100% протоколов

en.title: ER candidate wins State Duma elections in Khakassia after processing 100% of protocols
en.summary: A United Russia candidate has won the State Duma election in Khakassia with all polling protocols counted.

stories.title: ЕР лидирует на выборах в ГД в Поморье после обработки 50% протоколов

en.title: ER leads State Duma elections in Pomorie after processing 50% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections in Pomorie based on half of the counted polling protocols.

stories.title: ЕР лидирует на выборах в Госдуму после обработки 45,08 процентов протоколов

en.title: ER leads State Duma elections after processing 45.08 percent of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections according to results from 45.08 percent of processed polling protocols.

stories.title: ЕР лидирует на выборах в Госдуму после обработки 40,66 процентов протоколов

en.title: United Russia leads State Duma election after processing 40.66 percent of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in the State Duma election after election officials processed about 40.66 percent of the voting protocols.

en.title: United Russia receives 57.26% after processing 41.04% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading with 57.26% of votes after counting 41.04% of protocols, while the Communist Party received 13.84%, LDPR 9.09%, New People 7.97%, and Fair Russia 5.22%.

stories.title: «Единая Россия» набирает 56,97% голосов после обработки 32,92% протоколов

en.title: United Russia receives 56.97% of votes after processing 32.92% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading with 56.97% based on party lists after counting 32.92% of protocols, with other parties including the Communist Party at 13.95%, LDPR at 9.26%, New People at 8.06%, and Fair Russia at 5.22%.

stories.title: ЦИК опубликовал итоги выборов в Госдуму после обработки 35,07% протоколов

en.title: Central Election Commission publishes State Duma election results after processing 35.07% of protocols
en.summary: The Central Election Commission released preliminary State Duma election results after processing 35.07% of the voting protocols.

stories.title: ЦИК: «Единая Россия» лидирует с 57,04% после обработки 25% протоколов

en.title: Central Election Commission: United Russia leads with 57.04% after processing 25% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections with 57.04% of votes after 25% of protocols were processed, according to election commission data. The Communist Party of the Russian Federation follows with 13.9%, the Liberal Democratic Party with 9.31%, and other parties trailing behind.

stories.title: ЦИК: «Единая Россия» лидирует с 57,7% после обработки 20% протоколов

en.title: Central Election Commission: United Russia leads with 57.7% after processing 20% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections with 57.7% of votes after 20% of protocols were processed. The Communist Party follows with 14.04%, the Liberal Democratic Party with 9.31%, and New People with 7.93%.

stories.title: Володин набирает 99,08% на выборах по одномандатному округу после обработки первых протоколов

en.title: Volodin receives 99.08% in single-mandate district elections after processing initial protocols
en.summary: State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin is leading in single-mandate district 164 in Saratov Oblast with 99.08% after initial protocol processing. Russia held State Duma elections and regional legislative assembly elections from September 18 to 20.

stories.title: ЦИК России опубликовал первые результаты выборов в Госдуму. После обработки 14% протоколов у «Единой России» 57,5%

en.title: Russia's Central Election Commission published initial election results for State Duma. United Russia has 57.5% after processing 14% of protocols
en.summary: Russia's election commission released initial vote counts for State Duma elections, showing United Russia with 57.54% after 13.88% of protocols were processed. The Communist Party ranks second with 13.67% and the Liberal Democratic Party third with 9.27%.

stories.title: Из-за атак в дни выборов были повреждены 74 здания с избирательными комиссиями

en.title: 74 election commission buildings damaged in attacks during election days
en.summary: The head of Russia's election commission reported that 74 buildings housing election commissions in 10 regions were damaged or destroyed due to missile strikes, drone attacks, and other emergencies.

stories.title: Во всех одномандатных округах Подмосковья лидируют кандидаты «Единой России»

en.title: United Russia candidates leading in all single-mandate districts of Moscow region
en.summary: United Russia candidates are ahead in all 12 single-mandate districts of Moscow region in State Duma elections, with the party also securing over 50% of votes in regional assembly elections based on partial returns.

stories.title: Axios: Трамп просил Зеленского остановить удары по российским НПЗ

en.title: Axios: Trump asked Zelensky to stop strikes on Russian refineries
en.summary: According to Axios, U.S. President Donald Trump repeatedly asked Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky to halt attacks on Russian oil refineries due to rising global diesel prices.

en.title: Yabloko enters Novgorod regional parliament
en.summary: The Yabloko party is entering the Novgorod regional assembly with a preliminary result of 5.3% of votes, becoming the only region where the party was permitted to participate in regional elections.

stories.title: Кадыров на выборах главы Чечни набирает 97,35% голосов

en.title: Kadyrov receives 97.35% of votes in Chechen leadership election
en.summary: Ramzan Kadyrov from the United Russia party is winning the election for head of Chechnya with 97.35% of the vote after 2.4% of protocols have been processed.
